title: Flatten local events to NDJSON in n8n
skills_assessed: JSON item explode (Code or Split Out)
Writing NDJSON with n8n file nodes
before_you_start: n8n is on the desktop (launcher or http://127.0.0.1:5678/). Sign in with candidate@skillflare.local / Skillflare1.
File nodes can write to /data (same as /config/data). events.json and notes are on the desktop.

role.title: Automation / integration engineer
role.company_context: Ops-led SaaS company that uses self-hosted n8n to move internal JSON extracts onto a shared volume for downstream jobs. A small automation team owns editor workflows so feature teams are not writing one-off cron scripts. Hiring to strengthen day-to-day n8n workflow work on that team.
day_to_day: Build and run n8n workflows that read local JSON and write files under /data
Explode a single HTTP/file payload into canonical n8n items, then map a small output schema
Filter malformed rows (empty ids, non-numeric amounts) before writing
Keep Manual Trigger (or equivalent) executions predictable so QA can rerun the same job
Pair with ops engineers on “the canvas looks right but Execute failed” issues
required_skills: Comfortable building and executing a workflow in the n8n editor
Can turn one JSON array / file into multiple n8n items (Code node or Split Out)
Can filter on a field and map id / source / amount without passing nested meta through
Can write NDJSON (or equivalent line-oriented JSON) with a file node to a documented path
nice_to_have_skills: Familiarity with Read/Write Files from Disk, Extract From File, and Append/Write file nodes
Experience with Code node “Run Once for All Items” and returning [{json: …}]
Prior work on self-hosted n8n (not only n8n Cloud)
Comfort reading node errors when a file path is wrong
constraints: Assessment focuses on an n8n workflow over a provided local JSON extract — not GitHub, Slack, or a public SaaS integration
Do not test Redis queue mode, multi-host workers, Docker Compose, or n8n Cloud credentials
Candidate works in a desktop environment with the n8n editor, Terminal, and VS Code available
Starter files on the desktop are shared scenery; do not require inventing a different automation tool

problem_statement.title: Flatten kept events to NDJSON

outcomes: Open n8n (desktop launcher or http://127.0.0.1:5678/) and execute a workflow that reads events.json.
Keep rows whose status is paid; skip empty id and non-numeric amount; drop nested meta.
Write one NDJSON line per kept event (id, source, amount) to /data/events.ndjson.
constraints: Use n8n for the work sample. Do not replace it with a one-off Node, Python, or spreadsheet script.
Do not change events.json. Do not call GitHub, Slack, or other personal/SaaS APIs.
File nodes should write under /data (same volume as /config/data).
Starter files on the desktop stay as shared scenery — treat events.json as the extract you flatten.

rubric.name: Working n8n execution
rubric.summary: Demonstrates a successful Execute of an n8n workflow that reads the starter extract.
rubric.description: YES/NO: Did the candidate demonstrate a successful n8n Execute (editor execution list, success state, or a webhook POST that appears as a run) of a workflow that reads starter events.json? Answer YES only if video or narrative shows a completed run with no unresolved node error. Canvas-only, Node/Python-only, or inferred “probably works” = NO. YES = full points; NO or unclear = 0.

rubric.name: Correct NDJSON output
rubric.summary: Writes the instance’s three kept events to the documented /data file.
rubric.description: YES/NO: Does leftover /data/<instance output_file> (or /config/data) contain the three kept records for the instance keep-status in notes.md / brief, with id, source, and numeric amount, and without skipped ids (empty id, evt-bad, evt-skip, or wrong-status rows)? Answer YES only if all three instance keys match — not skeleton paid / events.ndjson when this instance differs. Wrong status, missing file, or all 15 input rows dumped = NO. Extra keys on a line are OK. YES = full points; NO or unclear = 0.

rubric.name: Item explode and field map
rubric.summary: Turns the JSON array into multiple n8n items and maps id, source, and amount.
rubric.description: YES/NO: Does the leftover workflow explode the file/array into multiple n8n items and map id / source / amount (meta dropped or unused), via a Code node returning canonical items or native Split Out + Filter / Edit Fields? Answer YES only if both explode and map are visible. Single-item dump of the whole array, or three hardcoded Set nodes with no read of events.json = NO. YES = full points; NO or unclear = 0.

rubric.name: Clarity of deliverables
rubric.summary: Leaves an n8n workflow and a /data output file a reviewer can find without guessing.
rubric.description: YES/NO: Is there a leftover n8n workflow (still in the editor or exported JSON) plus the documented /data file (or labeled results.md pointing at it) that a reviewer could reopen without guessing paths? Answer YES if both the workflow and output location are findable; optional notes must be accurate if present. Deleted workflow, output only spoken, or never opened n8n = NO. YES = full points; NO or unclear = 0.

invariants: Keep the same skills_assessed and rubric structure/weights
Keep the same deliverable kinds and difficulty band (n8n workflow + NDJSON under /data)
Keep events.json, three kept rows per keep-status, and skip rules (empty id, non-numeric amount, status filter)
Do not introduce GitHub, Slack, Redis queue mode, n8n Cloud, or a different automation tool
Do not rewrite events.json; keep the same 15-row extract across instances

apply.candidate_brief:
## Build the {{pipeline_label}} in n8n

A local JSON extract named `events.json` is on your desktop. n8n is already on this machine. Your job is to build and execute a workflow that flattens the kept events into NDJSON under `/data`.

### Outcomes
- Open n8n (desktop launcher or http://127.0.0.1:5678/) and execute a workflow that reads `events.json`.
- Keep rows whose `status` is `{{keep_status}}`; skip empty `id` and non-numeric `amount`; drop nested `meta`.
- Write one NDJSON line per kept event (`id`, `source`, `amount`) to `/data/{{output_file}}`.

### Constraints
- Use n8n for the work sample. Do not replace it with a one-off Node, Python, or spreadsheet script.
- Do not change `events.json`. Do not call GitHub, Slack, or other personal/SaaS APIs.
- File nodes should write under `/data` (same volume as `/config/data`).
- Starter files on the desktop stay as shared scenery — treat `events.json` as the extract you flatten.

### Deliverables
Leave an executed n8n workflow a reviewer can open on this desktop, plus `/data/{{output_file}}` (and optional `results.md`). Sign-in on this image is the baked owner account in Before you start.

files.notes.md:
# {{pipeline_label}}

Build and run an n8n workflow that reads `events.json`, keeps rows whose `status` is **{{keep_status}}**, drops malformed rows, and writes one NDJSON line per kept event to `/data/{{output_file}}`.

## Input

- File: `events.json` on the desktop (typical path `/config/Desktop/events.json`). You may copy it to `/data/events.json` before reading.
- Each object has `id`, `source`, `status`, `amount`, and nested `meta`.

## Keep / skip rules

- Keep only rows where `status` equals `{{keep_status}}`.
- Skip rows with an empty `id`.
- Skip rows whose `amount` is not a number.
- Drop `meta` (and any other extra fields) from the output.

## Output

Write newline-delimited JSON to **`/data/{{output_file}}`** (`/data` is the same volume as `/config/data`). Each line is one object:

```json
{"id":"<id>","source":"<source>","amount":<number>}
```

Use a Manual Trigger (or equivalent) and **Execute workflow** in the n8n editor. Do not replace n8n with a one-off Node/Python script as the work sample.
